story.theme_name: Late-career reflections: awards, legacy and life lessons
story.community_name: Looking back: no regrets, what it all meant

blocks.x: Is there anything that you've regretted over the course of your career?
No, surprisingly enough. No, not begrudge it. All these years of playing music, I still don't regret my move I made back in 19 -- when was that, 19--
1926. When I left school and went out to Milwaukee to play. Haven't regretted a minute of it.
I don't think you should. Was there anything, during all those years, that really stands out in your mind, being out of the ordinary?
Beyond the ordinary? I can't think of anything now.
